description: This source file implements the MPSGeneratorImpl class and related functions for managing a random number generator specific to Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch. It includes seed management, state serialization/deserialization, cloning, and offset handling for the generator.

classes.name: MPSGeneratorImpl
classes.description: A class implementing a random number generator for MPS backend in PyTorch, supporting seed setting, state management, offset handling, and cloning.

methods.name: get_default_mps_generator
methods.description: Returns a singleton default MPS generator instance.

methods.description: Creates a new MPSGeneratorImpl instance initialized with a specified seed.

methods.name: seed
